hooks.command: csid=$(cat 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*"session_id" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -s --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 "http://localhost:2208/api/notify?type=working&sessionId=$NINE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID&csid=$csid&tool=claude" > /dev/null 2>&1 & true
